title: Face fixing with GFPGAN
model: ICBINP - I Can't Believe It's Not Photography
notes: The two requests are identical apart from params.post_processing and params.facefixer_strength, so the pair isolates what the face fixer does. Face fixing is a post-processor, not a sampler setting: it runs on the finished image, so the composition is unchanged and only facial detail is redrawn. Pinned to world 1 on the photoreal SD1.5 model, because GFPGAN is trained on photographic faces: the anime world would be a mismatch to publish and the robot has no face to fix.
